description: ZP-MC10A-2-SBHMC is the drawing identifier for connector protective cover in AutomationDirect's ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors collection. A connector cover protects or closes the selected connector interface in its documented use. It is different from the connector insert and may need its own operating or removal space.

For example, in a panel service connector that is covered when the mating plug is absent, use the ZP-MC10A-2-SBHMC reference to coordinate cover motion, retention and access to the mating interface. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors/ZP-MC10A-2-SBHMC.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
